posts.title: Who Was the Stranger Who Came to the Prophet ﷺ?
posts.caption:
Who Was the Stranger Who Came to the Prophet ﷺ?

In one amazing hadith, a stranger comes into the gathering of the Messenger ﷺ — a man, extremely white, with no spot or sign of fatigue or travel. None of them knew him. He sits with his knees touching the knees of the Prophet ﷺ and says: "Ya Muhammad, tell me about Islam." The Prophet ﷺ answers — and the man says: "You spoke the truth."
